mapper.insert: INSERT INTO verification (PURPOSE, CHANNEL, IDENTIFIER, CODE, ATTEMPTS, CREATED_AT, VERIFIED_AT) VALUES (#{purpose}, #{channel}, #{identifier}, #{code}, #{attempts}, #{createdAt}, #{verifiedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE verification SET CODE = #{code}, ATTEMPTS = 0, CREATED_AT = #{createdAt}, VERIFIED_AT = NULL WHERE PURPOSE = #{purpose} AND CHANNEL = #{channel} AND IDENTIFIER = #{identifier}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM verification WHERE PURPOSE = #{purpose} AND CHANNEL = #{channel} AND IDENTIFIER = #{identifier}
DELETE FROM verification WHERE (VERIFIED_AT IS NULL AND CREATED_AT < #{codeCutoff}) OR (VERIFIED_AT IS NOT NULL AND VERIFIED_AT < #{verifiedCutoff})
